games.identify.intro: We show you a constellation and you pick its correct name from four options. The faster you answer and the longer your streak of correct answers, the more points you earn.
games.identify.hard: Only the stars are visible; the lines appear after you answer. Double points.
games.identify.question: Which constellation is this?
games.connect.intro: Connect the stars of the given constellation: tap two stars one after the other and a line is drawn between them. Wrong taps and hints cost points.
games.connect.easy: A faint guide line shows the shape.
games.connect.hard: No guide line, only the hint button. Double points.
games.connect.wrongLine: These two stars are not connected in this constellation.
games.connect.wrongStar: This star does not belong to this constellation.
games.connect.duplicate: You have already drawn this line.
games.belief.intro: You read a short description of a belief or fact about a constellation, with its name blanked out. Pick the star pattern that matches the description from four options. Descriptions of the western constellations are in English.
games.belief.hard: You only get the first 3 sentences. Double points.
games.belief.question: Which star pattern fits the description?
